certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official Alaska Division of Elections ENR precinct CSV aggregated to the 40 mapped State House Districts. The non-geographic HD99 Federal Overseas Absentee bucket is documented but excluded from the map-aligned district total.

turnout.notes: Turnout is not loaded in this New York-level pass. The official Alaska ENR CSV includes registered-voter and ballot fields that can be mapped in a later turnout upgrade.

certifiedResults.title: Alaska official presidential house district results
certifiedResults.detail: Official Alaska Division of Elections ENR by-precinct CSV is aggregated to the 40 mapped State House Districts. The official page marks the 2024 General Election results status as Official. HD99 Federal Overseas Absentee contains 401 presidential votes but has no district polygon, so it is documented and excluded from the map-aligned district total.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Alaska Division of Elections 2024 General Election page says Results Status: Official and Page last updated January 29, 2025 at 2:58 pm.

wardDetail.title: Alaska official precinct detail
wardDetail.detail: The official ENR CSV includes precinct-level presidential rows. This pass aggregates them to House District totals for the map; review drilldowns stay disabled until the precinct rows are mapped into the review graph schema.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official ENR by-precinct CSV collected during Alaska load.

turnout.title: Alaska turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The official ENR CSV includes registered-voter and ballot fields, but this pass only loads certified presidential district totals. Turnout remains disabled until those fields are mapped and validated as the accepted denominator.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official ENR by-precinct CSV checked during Alaska load.

checkedNotUsable.reason: HD99 has 401 official presidential votes but no matching State House District polygon in the 40-feature map geometry. It is excluded from the map-aligned district total rather than assigned to an arbitrary district.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: If the app gains a non-geographic results bucket, add HD99 as a separate non-map row.
